swimmers.disputed: Two birth dates in the archive and the swimmer's recorded age jumps two years between consecutive meets. Meets from 2023-01 to 2025-10 record him as 9 rising to 12, consistent with 2013-05-15, which is also what his athlete ID encodes (17 of 24 meet-age records agree). From 2025-11 onward he is recorded as 14 then 15, consistent with 2011-05-16, which is what the KA National Time Trials export of 2026-09-19 states (7 of 24 agree, but they are the most recent). Either he was registered two years too young until Nov 2025, or a wrong date was entered then and has persisted. The club must decide: it changes which age band he is judged in and whether he was racing the right age group. Until then he is banded on his athlete ID and this row stops the guard failing on a fault that is known.
